title: Ship unified skgo checking, linting, formatting, and fixes

labels.name: bounded-hard
labels.description: Clear endpoint and acceptance; implementation or diagnosis needs a larger model.

milestone.title: Total SvelteKit support
milestone.description:
Track SvelteKit server-facing parity for skgo's Go-owned application model. The [49-row feature matrix](https://tylergannon.github.io/skgo/features.html) is the inventory: 29 rows are currently Available; this milestone tracks the 20 Limited, Not verified, WIP, or Not supported rows.

Work by capability:
- Pages and routing: #159 optional parameters and matchers, #160 universal loads, #161 load invalidation, #81 Go loads during prerender, #162 dynamic entries, #163 route options.
- Actions and remotes: #164 classic actions, shared route dispatch, and action CSRF; #174 remote prerender functions.
- Requests and server behavior: #165 handleFetch, #166 handleValidationError, #167 reroute, #168 server init, #169 fetch, #170 env/platform context, #171 server-only isolation, #172 asset read, #173 instrumentation.
- Developer tooling: #175 unified checking/fixes and #176 MCP plus versioned docs.

A capability is done when it works with the pinned Kit 3 version in development and a built Go server, with a concrete example or focused behavioral proof, and the README/site matrix reflects the result. For a Not verified row, first establish actual behavior; a working case can close after proof, while a real gap remains open until resolved.

Intentional product boundaries: application server endpoints and I/O remain in Go, so handwritten TypeScript server implementations are excluded. skgo deploys as a Go binary, so Node/serverless/edge adapters are separate targets. Those two matrix rows are recorded here as exclusions, not open implementation issues. Other rows need explicit resolution against Kit's pinned source.

No due date or release version is implied.

body:
## Desired result

A developer should have one skgo command for Go, Svelte, TypeScript, generated bindings, lint, and formatting diagnostics, with a deliberate fix mode.

## Acceptance

A fresh generated app can run the command; deliberate authored errors are reported with useful locations; fix mode changes only applicable files and rechecks; missing tooling cannot yield a clean result.

## Current boundary

The example has a separate `svelte-check` script, while integrated checking and fixes are WIP in the agent-tooling task.

Feature matrix: https://tylergannon.github.io/skgo/features.html. Kit’s pinned source and client behavior define compatibility.
